name: gritive
description: Comprehensive codebase review plugin with parallel reviewers, a review-until-clean loop, persona-based UX testing, and RFP-to-project bootstrapping workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Code review, persona testing, and project bootstrap workflows
interface.longDescription: Use Gritive to run structured codebase reviews, iterate on review findings until the actionable queue is empty, test services from customer personas, and bootstrap RFP-driven projects into PRDs, issues, and implementation loops.
defaultPrompt: Run a codebase review on my current changes.
Test this service from a customer persona.
Bootstrap this RFP into a project plan.
